title: Strict-2D full Coulomb construction algorithm for LibRPA reader-v1

out_librpa_2d_coulomb_method.meaning: Selects the strict-2D full auxiliary Coulomb construction: ewald (established split-Ewald output) or direct_mixed_fourier (positive Gram matrix).

adjust.symptom: strict-2D EXX or GW bands are wrong and the Coulomb matrix is suspect
adjust.effect: cross-check with the other algorithm (ewald versus direct_mixed_fourier)
adjust.guard: direct_mixed_fourier requires rpa=1, out_librpa_reader_version=1, exx_ewald_dimension=2, positive out_librpa_2d_direct_ecut, positive out_librpa_2d_direct_kz_order, and a positive even out_librpa_2d_direct_gamma_order

constraints: direct_mixed_fourier is default-off and has no automatic fallback.
The three direct-mode parameters must each be converged.
